scope: CPU/source-only validation; no environment construction, EGL, model loading, training or task rollouts performed for this registration
source_choice: Previously fixed task0/init0; source trajectory selected before any NoLang/poisoning outcomes. Source is a development case, not a representative or independent test episode.

split_protocol.selection_basis: Fixed training prefix and one-window purge; heldout count and positions depend only on trace length, never forecast loss or task/attack effects.
split_protocol.statistical_unit: One source trajectory; adjacent within-partition windows are correlated and may share boundary images. Heldout windows are not independent episodes.

selection_rule.rule: Use all complete six-action windows remaining after fixed 30 training windows plus one boundary purge. Here 293//6-31=17. No count, location or dose chosen from prediction/attack effects.

native_all_task_gate.criterion: At least 21/30 successes and at least 7/10 tasks; fixed all-task protocol

cpu_validation.camera_mismatch_native_gate_rejected: Native task gate camera_size does not match
self_test_checks: schema1/2 and missing split version rejected
legacy collector filtering checked with CPU stub, no rendering

gate_requirements.normal_health_criterion: At least one Frozen success, and no Frozen-success init lost by NoLangTTT. Development health check only, not statistical equivalence.
gate_requirements.normal_gate_reuse: Requires exact protocol_identity_sha256, including camera, source-summary/trace hashes, schema/split, data cache hash, code hashes and model device. Old 224 or legacy-split health gates cannot be reused.
gate_requirements.extended_arms: Require completed normal health gate plus matched128 native gate 21/30 and >=7 successful tasks; preserve all30 baseline results.

threat_model.attacker_capability_assumption: Rewrite only pretokenized cached .npy['text']; no access to physical data, actions, targets, policy Goal or deployed parameters directly.
threat_model.online_sampler_boundary: Released CALVIN sampler canonicalizes adaptation text to literal 'no lang'; modifying legal policy Goal alone does not alter it.
threat_model.implementation_scope: LIBERO reconstruction replays immutable physical data.pt and loads separately serialized token-only .npy metadata with the same dictionary text-field convention. Not the missing official LIBERO trainer.
held_fixed: native deployment mask and original policy Goal
threat_model.goal_ttt_status: Original task-goal metadata diagnostic, not a native normal-adaptation baseline.

preparation_implementation: Reuse core exact-control replay with collector prefix31 solely to collect later heldout frames; discard purge interior frame183 and restore30 training windows in new schema3 cache. No core globals or old core file changed.
actual_future_replay_checks_required: Replay actions as np.float16 exactly, with raw camera128 and original seed/settling/state codecs
Check BDDL and initial-state hashes against source
Check every available source eef/quaternion/gripper/reward/done/success value through step288
Do not claim pixel/full-simulator-state identity: original source trace did not save pixels/full states
No adaptation dose selection using heldout errors
17 windows from same trajectory are correlated; cannot count as17 independent episodes; source-init task outcome is development only
